lines.beaver_en: Is the seating arrangement all done?
lines.en: Yes, I arranged the seats by region.

lines.beaver_en: Where do the southern region guests sit?
lines.learner: 남부 지역은 무대 오른편에 앉도록 했어요.
lines.en: I had the southern region sit on the right side of the stage.
lines.roman: nambu jiyeogeun mudae oreunpyeone andorok haesseoyo.

lines.en: The central region is on the opposite side, the left.

lines.learner: 외부 손님은 무대 양옆에 앉으시도록 했어요.
lines.en: I had outside guests sit on both sides of the stage.
lines.roman: oebu sonnimeun mudae yangnyeope anjeusidorok haesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Which side are the entrance and windows on?
lines.learner: 입구는 북쪽, 창문은 동쪽과 서쪽에 있어요.
lines.en: The entrance is north, and the windows are east and west.
lines.roman: ipguneun bukjjok, changmuneun dongjjokgwa seojjoge isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Won't it be a bit hot indoors?
lines.learner: 그래서 창문 쪽 자리는 비워 두었어요.
lines.en: So I left the seats by the windows empty.
lines.roman: geuraeseo changmun jjok jarineun biwo dueosseoyo.

lines.en: I'll have them sit in the empty seats in back.

lines.beaver_en: Is the distance between seats okay?
lines.learner: 네, 의자 간 거리를 넓게 했어요.
lines.en: Yes, I made the space between chairs wide.
lines.roman: ne, uija gan georireul neolkke haesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: The right aisle isn't blocked, right?
lines.en: Right, I kept the right side clear as an aisle.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Please check the guest list too.
lines.learner: 네, 시작 시각 전에 꼭 확인하도록 할게요.
lines.en: Sure, I'll be sure to check it before the start time.
lines.roman: ne, sijak sigak jeone kkok hwaginhadorok halgeyo.
